newsitem.title: USA: Mossimo sees Q1 loss up to $0.03/share.
newsitem.headline: Mossimo sees Q1 loss up to $0.03/share.

text.p: Mossimo Inc said Friday it expects to report a loss of as much as $500,000, or $0.03 a share, for the first quarter, on net sales of $24.5 million.
The company said it expects the loss to include a one-time charge of $950,000, primarily for discontinuing its TIME division and severance costs from a seven percent work force decrease.
Mossimo said it would report first quarter results May 8.
For the 1996 first quarter Mossimo had sales of $24.1 million and a pro forma net profit of $4 million, or $0.28 per share.

"Lower sales of men's activewear that typically carry higher margins, and increased expenses including certain one-time charges, contributed to a disappointing quarter," Chief Financial Officer Tony Cherbak said in a statement.
It said it expects that softness in its men's activewear business will continue, at least in the near term.
